entries.name: EditBlockMove
entries.note: Whole-line block operations and independent endpoints. Modern V1 policy: moving a contiguous block directly before its already-adjacent successor is a successful no-op (no Dirty/version/Undo change); real earlier-target moves and associated topology remain undoable. This corner case is not a claim about original DOS Undo bookkeeping.
